jobs.description: We're building the future of urban stays. One city at a time.Homaris exists to solve one of the most persistent problems in modern cities: People from abroad need places to live, work, and just feel at home. We build and operate fully digitised serviced apartments across Germany´s major cities – next step: Europe and beyond.And a product vision — the nanopartment® — that reimagines what urban stays can look like in the smallest possible space.Revenue triples within two years — organically. No venture capital. No exit strategy. We are in this for the long run, and we build accordingly.Extraordinary people make this happen - and we're looking for one more.Your RoleAs our CFO, you are responsible for all finance processes and decisions, and for growing the finance function across the Homaris Group from our Berlin office. You will have a great deal of freedom to build processes and structures, and you will play a decisive role in the company's growth by securing external financing and therefore our liquidity.This is a role with full ownership. You will shape how we budget, forecast, and steer the business, and you will prepare the finance function for the next stage of our expansion.If you've done this before in a demanding environment and you're looking for a place where the stakes are real and the room to grow is genuine, this could be the opportunity you have been looking for.What You'll Do Lead and structure the team. You take full ownership of budgeting and forecasting, and you develop short- and medium-term financial planning to secure the company's liquidity. You also manage payment flows.Assess investments. You prepare profitability analyses for planned and realised investments.Build company-wide controlling. This includes overseeing financial accounting, preparing and presenting actuals, analysing budget versus actuals, forecasting, and monitoring the liquidity position.Secure financing. You evaluate equity and debt financing, lead fundraising, hold discussions with banks and investors, and manage investor relationships.Digitalise finance. You drive the digitalisation of finance processes and establish the processes that go with it, automating and enabling AI where it makes sense to do so.What Makes You a Fit Qualifications and skillset. You have a (university of applied sciences) degree in business administration with a focus on finance or controlling, or a commercial apprenticeship with further training as a certified bookkeeper or controller, or an equivalent qualification. You also possess strong knowledge of finance and tax law, particularly under German GAAP (HGB), and are well versed in DATEV.Leadership and growth. You have at least five years of experience in finance and accounting, including leadership responsibility, ideally in a company with organic growth. You plan, organise, and implement with strength, and you think and act like an entrepreneur.Ownership and commitment. You bring a structured, independent, and responsible way of working, and a high level of commitment. You take ownership of outcomes and are confident and reliable.Tech affinity. You have a keen interest in digitalisation and continuously strive to implement AI and digital solutions, to save the team time and help them work in the most efficient way possible.Languages: German at native level (C2) and English at least at C1.The EnvironmentHomaris is a company with the maximum of long-term orientation. We don't burn cash to grow fast and sell. We build something real, and we expect the people who join us to want to build it with us — not to optimise for others.The pace is high. The problems are real. The team is small enough that every person matters.We're not always great at seeing and celebrating our wins. But we're working on it — and we'd love your help with that.What We OfferWe define levels by the work you own and the decisions you're accountable for, not by your title or years of experience.Beyond that: we've thought carefully about what people actually need to do their best work and live well — and we've built a benefits package that reflects that. Health, mobility, development, flexibility, and a few perks that come with being in the travel and hospitality business. Not much is missing.We'll walk you through the details when we meet.Next StepsIf this opportunity resonates with you, we’d be glad to learn more about your experience and perspective.We will just need your CV and a short answer to the following 3 questions:• Why Homaris?• Given that we are owner-led and grow organically, what is one thing you would do differently here, based on what you've learned in past roles?• What could we learn from you?Please include at least two references in your application to speed things up.Questions? Reach out to Naomi at karriere@homaris.de or +49 157 92465851.About usHomaris is a leading provider of serviced nano-apartments in prime urban locations and is pioneering a new generation of space-efficient apartment concepts with its nanopartment®. With more than 4,500 apartments secured under contract in cities including Berlin, Hamburg, Munich, Cologne, Frankfurt, Stuttgart, Düsseldorf and Dresden, Homaris ranks among Germany’s leading serviced-apartment brands. The company serves contemporary customer segments, including business travellers, tourists, digital nomads and corporate clients.The Homaris concept is based on the integration of a fully digitalised guest journey with maximum space efficiency, multifunctional design and intelligent space solutions. The nanopartment® is Homaris’s signature product, embodying innovative space efficiency, modern minimalism and a modular design concept that combines living, working and a sense of arrival within a compact footprint. jobs.description: About usAirbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.Job description In order to support the Mission Functions department, Airbus Helicopters is looking for anInternship (d/f/m) within the mission software departmentAre you looking for an internship and want to get to know the work of an Embedded Software Engineer (d/f/m)?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Mission Functions department as an intern (d/f/m)!- Location: Donauwörth- Start: February 2027- Duration: 6 monthsYour locationAt our Donauwörth site, located on the banks of the river Danube, we develop helicopters from the initial idea to the airworthy product. Watch them take off and touch down on our own on-site test airfield.Your benefits- Attractive salary and work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.- Traveling within Europe (team events) is possible after consultation and agreement from the department.- Work with modern/diversified technologies- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.Your tasks and responsibilities- Collaborate with the transversal team to design, code software in programming languages like C, ADA, etc.- Work on embedded systems to integrate and verify software with hardware components.- Debug and troubleshoot existing software to improve reliability.- Assist in requirements analysis for implementing them in the software.- Participate in testing and validation of the embedded software.- Collaborate with team members to align software solutions.- Contribute to the team’s innovation by suggesting improvements or new ideas for the software development process.- Write and maintain Python scripts for DevOps tasks, for continuous integration and improve the processes.Desired skills and qualifications- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) in the area of IT, computer Science or an equivalent field of study.- Knowledge in programming languages (Python, C, C++, .).- Basic experience in agile software development methods would be a plus.- Ability to work in teams and solve complex technical problems.- Ability to manage time effectively, meet deadlines, and work on multiple tasks simultaneously, especially in a dynamic environment.- Fluent in English.Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!#MYCYMThis job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growthBy submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.
